name: snowflake-cortex-code
description: Route Snowflake prompts to the Cortex Code CLI on your machine, including database migrations with Snowflake AIM
shortDescription: Snowflake work with CoCo CLI + AIM

setup.notice: Runs the Cortex Code CLI on the machine where Devin runs, with your own Snowflake connection. Use Devin CLI or Devin Desktop; for zero-install access from any Devin, use Snowflake (Managed MCP) instead.
steps: In a Devin session, run `/snowflake-cortex-code:cortex-setup`. It installs the Cortex Code CLI and Snowflake AIM (for database migrations) and walks you through a Snowflake connection.
Or skip AIM for now: it is offered again the first time you ask for a migration.
Start a new session and ask a Snowflake question; the plugin routes it to Cortex Code.
